{{short description|Japanese mathematician}}
'''Takeshi Saito''' (斎藤 毅 Saitō Takeshi, born 11 September 1961) is a Japanese mathematician, specializing in some areas of [[number theory]] and [[algebraic geometry]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Takeshi Saito's Home Page|website=Department of Mathematics, University of Tokyo|url=https://www.ms.u-tokyo.ac.jp/~t-saito/}}</ref> His thesis advisor was [[Kazuya Kato]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=174875}}</ref> 

Saito was an invited speaker of the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in 2010.<ref>{{cite book|doi=10.1142/9789814324359_0054|chapter=Wild Ramification of Schemes and Sheaves|title=Proceedings of the International Congress of Mathematicians 2010 (ICM 2010)|volume=2|pages=335–356|year=2011|last1=Saito|first1=Takeshi|isbn=978-981-4324-30-4}}</ref>
